verificationSummary: Editor commit 7dc118a23a993c5fb7ca6168ee77027dc9324cfa wires the active text-block island Backend lifecycle into Editor runtime. It updates src/editor/draft/activeTextBlockIsland.ts, src/editor/runtime/editorState.ts, src/editor/runtime/runtimeBackendMutation.ts, docs/TEXT_BLOCK_AUTHORING_BOUNDARY.md, and adds src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandLifecycle.test.ts. EditorRuntimeState now starts with inactive active-island state; resolving a text-block island commit records pending request metadata by request id, base revision, local draft revision, and requested time; the stale-gated Backend mutation apply path updates active-island state only for matching text-block.rich-inline.replace results. A current draft is cleared after its matching pending commit is applied. A newer local draft is preserved when an older pending commit is rejected or stale. A newer local draft is rebased to the applied Backend revision when an older pending commit is applied. The accepted RED was npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandLifecycle.test.ts failing with activeTextBlockIsland undefined and helper opening failures. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandLifecycle.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts src/tests/v4ReadOnly.test.ts src/tests/boundary.test.ts with 5 test files and 19 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, 93 test files with 323 tests, and build. This evidence does not enable visible text input, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, field-chip input, rich-inline flattening, React canvas input binding, collaboration, durable draft persistence, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
